<entry id="L00343">
<head-word>לֶחִי</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>לְחִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> לחה; cmp. לוֹעָא)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>joint</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>jaw</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 18 לוחות שיגיעתן בל' the tablets are called 
<italic>lu</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>oth</italic>, because they must be studied with weariness of the 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic> (jaw).—
<italic>Du</italic>. לְחָיַיִם. Erub. 54
<sup>a</sup> (play on לחת, Ex. XXXI, 18) אם משים אדם לְחָיָיו כאבן וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if one will make his jaws as (untiring in repeating lessons as) a stone &c. Cant. R. to IV, 15; ib. to V, 12 (ref. to ib. 13) זה מלחים … עד שתהא הלכה יוצאה כמין ל' one scholar inserts one thing, another another thing, until the 
<italic>halakhah</italic> (decision) comes forth like jaws (well adjusted). Sabb. 57
<sup>b</sup> (expl. סרביטין, ib. VI, 1) המגיעין לה עד לְחָיֶיהָ ed. (Ms. M. המגיעין עד הלחיים) ornaments of the head which hang down so as to reach her cheeks. Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Lam. R. to II, 2 יעלו עשבים בלְחָיֶיךָ וכ' grass will grow through thy jaws (thou shalt be dead and buried), and the son of David shall not yet have appeared. Tosef. Ohol. I, 6 והלְחָיַיִן עמהן (ed. Zuck. והלחי) and the jaw-bones count among them. Ḥull. X, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>various objects resembling a jaw</italic>, or 
<italic>attached to another object</italic>; a) 
<italic>that part of the bridle which encompasses the jaw.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XI, 5.—b) 
<italic>the cheek-pieces of a casque</italic>. Ib. 8 (v. Maim. comment. ed. Dehr.).—c) 
<italic>inserted sticks, with which the plough is guided</italic>. Ib. XXI, 2.—Esp. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i, a stake fastened in the ground</italic> by the side of a wall, serving as a mark or as a fictitious partition (enclosure) for the purpose of enabling the inmates of an alley to move objects, on the Sabbath, within the space thus enclosed (v. 
<xref rid="P00680">עֵירוּב</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Erub. 12
<sup>b</sup> ל' משום מחיצה a 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic> is to serve the place of a partition (palisade), contrad. to משום היכר a mark to distinguish the alley from the public road. Ib. I, 2 הכשר מבוי … ל' וקורה the means of fitting an alley for movements on the Sabbath … are a stake and a beam on top; ר' אל' אומר לְחָיַיִן R. E. says two stakes. Ib. 6 לחיין שאמרו וכ' the stakes about which they speak must be ten hand-breadths high &c. Ib. 15
<sup>a</sup> ל' העומד מאליו … הוי ל' a pole put up accidentally (not with the intention of making it a Sabbath mark) … serves the ritual purposes of a 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic>. Ib. 12
<sup>b</sup> הִכְשִׁירוֹ בל' if the alley has been made available for Sabbath movements by means of a 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic>; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00344">
<head-word>לִחְיָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the cheek-piece of a bridle</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. לְחִיאָתָא</plural-form>. Hos. XI, 4 ומוריך בלְחִיאָתְהוֹן ed. (ed. Lag. בלַחְוָתָא; oth.ed. לְחוֹאָתָא, לֹוחֲאָ', לחיאתא, omitting the suffix) lengthening (loosening) their bridles (h. text לחיהם).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>stake</italic> as a Sabbath mark, 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="L00343">preced.</xref> Erub. 15
<sup>a</sup> נפל ל' the 
<italic>le</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>i</italic> had fallen over.</definition>
<notes>—V. לְחָיָיתָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00345">
<head-word>לְחַיֵי</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> adv. (לחי, cmp. Aeth.</definition>
<notes> la-ḥa-ya 
<italic>to be beautiful</italic>; cmp. יָפֶה, כָּשֵׁר) 
<italic>very well, all right</italic>. Targ. Ruth III, 13.—Gitt. 67
<sup>b</sup> bot. א"ל ל' said he to him, Very well (do so). Erub. 15
<sup>a</sup> בשלמא קמה ל' as regards grain stacks, very well (they may have been so arranged on purpose); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00346">
<head-word>לְחָיָיתָא</head-word>
<head-word>לְחַיָּ'</head-word>
<pos> f. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="L00344">לִחְיָא</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>palisades</italic>, whence לְחָיַית מו̇אָב, לְחַיָּת = עָר (מו̇אָב)
<pos> pr. n. pl.</pos>
<italic>Fort</italic> (
<italic>of Moab</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Num. XXI, 15 לְחַיָּת; Y. לחיית. Ib. O. 28 לחית 
<pgbrk id="pg703" />מואב (Y. II ל' קרתהון וכ'). In gen. 
<italic>fortresses</italic>. Targ. Esth. IX, 27.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00349">
<head-word>לְחִיכָה</head-word>

<sense>
<definition> (לָחַךְ) 
<italic>licking, lapping</italic> (of flames).</definition>
<notes> Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>b</sup> bot. והיתה האש מלחכת אותן כלְחִיכָתָן מסיני and flaming tongues lapped them (the words) as they were lapped when coming down from Sinai.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. לְחֵינָן, לְחֵינָתָא, לְחֵנָ'</plural-form>. Targ. I Kings XI, 3. Targ. O. Gen. XXV, 6. Targ. Y. ib. XX, 17. Targ. Job XIX, 15.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00353">
<head-word>לְחִישָׁה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (לָחַשׁ II) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>whisper; spell, charm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>b</sup> bot. (expl. לחשים, Is. III, 20) קדשייא דבר שהוא ניתן על בית הל' ear-rings, (namely) that which is put on the place where the whispering for charming purposes is done (the ear).—בל' 
<italic>in a low voice</italic>. Gen. R. s. 3, beg.; a. fr.—[Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>d</sup> top, v. לְחָשָׁא.].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>hissing</italic> (of the serpent), 
<italic>emission of venom.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. II, 10 לְחִישָׁתָן לְחִישַׁת וכ' their (the scholars’) hissing is that of &c.; Num. R. s. 3, beg.—Trnsf. 
<italic>invidious talk, tale-bearing, insinuation</italic>. Pes. 57
<sup>a</sup> אוי לי מלחישתן woe to me on account of their talk; Tosef. Men. XIII, 21 בית לחישתן their mouth.—
<plural-form>Pl. לְחִישׁוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Sot. XIV, 3; Sot. 47
<sup>b</sup> לוחשי ל' בדין those influencing the court by means of secret talk or insinuations.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00354">
<head-word>לָחַךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to lick, lap</italic> (cmp. לָחַת).</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> bot. לוֹחֲכָהּ בלשונו והיא וכ' he licks it (the ink) off with his tongue (from the interspaces of the letters) so that the Divine Name remains intact. Ḥull. 142
<sup>a</sup> פה … יִלְחוֹךְ עפר Oh that the mouth which gave forth pearls must now lick dust!; Kidd. 39
<sup>b</sup> יְלַחֵךְ (
<italic>Pi.</italic>). Esth. R. to IV, 15 כי לוֹחֵךְ הייתי וכ' for I should have been willing to lick the shoe of his (Haman’s) foot; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>לִיחֵךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, esp. (of lapping flames) 
<italic>to lick up, dry up, make glowing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 6
<sup>a</sup> לִחֲכָה נירו (Rashi לִי') it (the fire) lapped his neighbor’s ploughed field. Gen. R. s. 4, beg.; Yalk. Job 914. Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>b</sup> bot. מְלָחֶכֶת, v. לְחִיכָה. (Ruth R. to III, 13 מלהטת).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00355">
<head-word>לְחַךְ</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. I Kings XXI, 19 (h. text לקק). Ib. XVIII, 38. Targ. Mal. III, 19 יִלְחוֹךְ ed. Lag. (some ed. יַלְחֵיךְ 
<italic>Af</italic>.; h. text להט, v. preced.); a. e.—Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>a</sup> לַחֲכוּהָ לשקיה they burned (cauterized) his shoulder (to get the poison out)…</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>לָחֵיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>. same. Targ. Jud. VII, 5. Targ. Is. LXIV, 1; a. e.—Pes. 49
<sup>a</sup> מְלָחֵיךְ פינכי dish-licker.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00356">
<head-word>לִחְלוּחַ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (לחח, v. 
<xref rid="L00333">לַח</xref>) 
<italic>moisture</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to II, 1 כבר יש בו ל' there is still some moisture in it; (Midr. Till. to Ps. I לחלוחית).—V. לִכְלוּךְ.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00357">
<head-word>לִחְלוּחָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. לִחְלוּחֵי</plural-form>. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42
<sup>a</sup> אין עבדת ל' if it gives out juice.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00358">
<head-word>לִחְלוּחִית</head-word>
<head-word>לִיחְ'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>moisture, juice; vitality</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 48 זקנה שיש בה ל' (Ar. לכלוכית) old age combined with vitality. Ib. s. 61, beg. (ref. to יונקתו, Job XIV, 7) זו ל' שלו that means his vitality. Snh. 49
<sup>a</sup> עדיין לי' של וכ' David was yet in full vigor. Ib. 92
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ez. XXXVII, 4; 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> ‘dry bones’ are men שאין בהם ל' של מצוה in whom there is no sap of good deeds; Sot. 46
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Yalk. Kings 226; a. e.—[Cant. R. to I, 6 ועלה ל', read: לִכְלוּכִית.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00359">
<head-word>לִחְלוּחְתָּא</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42
<sup>a</sup> ל' אסורה the juice (brine of fish prepared by gentiles) is forbidden.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00360">
<head-word>לִחְלוּךְ</head-word>
<head-word>לִיחְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (לָחַךְ), ל' פה 
<italic>lapping with the tongue into the mouth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 22; Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 58
<sup>a</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 16; Yalk. Num. 776; Yalk. Job 926; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12 [read:] וכי יש בהם כדי לחלוך פה (not לכלוך, לחלוח) is there in them (the waters of the Jordan) enough (for the Behemoth) for a lapping? [or ויש בהם כדי ל' פה and there is just enough for etc.]—Ib. אין בהם [כדי] ל' פה there is not enough &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00361">
<head-word>לִחְלֵחַ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (redupl. of לחח, v. 
<xref rid="L00333">לַח</xref>) 
<italic>to moisten</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְלַחְלֵחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be moistened</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 36 (expl. איש האדמה, Gen. IX, 20) שבשבילו נִתְלַחְלְחָה האדמה since for his sake the ground became moist again (cmp. Gen. R. s. 33, end, quot. s. v. גְּרִיד). Y. Sabb. IV, 6
<sup>d</sup> bot. יבישין שנִתְלַחְלְחוּ dry (plants) which have been moistened again, opp. לחין מחמת עצמן, v. לַח.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00362">
<head-word>לַחְלַח</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Gen. R. s. 41 (expl. מוגיך, Is. LI, 23) אילין דממיגין מחתיך דמְלַחְלְחִין מחתיך (some ed. מכתך) those who make thy wounds flow, who moisten thy wounds, v. 
<xref rid="M00121">מוּג</xref></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00363">
<head-word>לָחַם</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. לוּחַ), 
<italic>to join</italic>, or 
<italic>to be joined, be inserted</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִלְחִים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to fit, insert; to tenon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XII, 13
<sup>c</sup> המַלְחִים את וכ' he who inserts the shutters (of a shop); Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>c</sup> המלחם (corr. acc.). Cant. R. to V, 12; ib. to IV, 15, v. לְחִי. Lev. R. s. 3 (ref. to the harmonious parallelism of Is. LV, 7) כאדם שהוא מלחים שני נסרים ומדביקן זה לזה as one fits (with tenon and mortise) two boards and glues them to one another; כאדם שהוא מ' שתי כרעי המטה (leave out ומדביקן זה לזה, v. Ar. s. v. מלח) as one inserts two legs of a bedstead.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00364">
<head-word>לָחַם</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="L00363">preced.</xref>) 
<italic>to join</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִלְחָם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. use of זָוַג 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic>) 
<italic>to come in</italic> (
<italic>hostile</italic>) 
<italic>contact, to battle</italic>; with ל of person, 
<italic>to assist, battle for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. B’shall. 2 (ref. to Ex. XIV, 14) לא … יִלָּחֵם לכם אלא לעולם ילחם כנגדן וכ' not only this time will he assist you, but he will always battle against your enemies. Tanḥ. Masé 6 כשהלך להִלָּחֵם בישראל when he (Sisera) went to war against &c. Ib. Vayera 7 (ref. בלחומו, Job XX, 23) על המלחמות שהיו נִלְחָמִים עם וכ' for the battles which they fought against the Lord; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְלַחֵם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to contest, dispute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, 81
<sup>d</sup> top אם חברים מִתְלַחֲמִים וכ' if scholars are at variance with 
<pgbrk id="pg704" />one another, what concern is it to you? (B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> מנצחים זה את זה וכ').</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00365">
<head-word>לֶחֶם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> fr. לחח 
<italic>to chew</italic>, v. Ges. H. Dict.
<sup>10</sup> s. v. לוע) 
<italic>food, bread;</italic> [Arab.</definition>

Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 1. Targ. Gen. XLIII, 5. Ib. O. XLII, 13. Ib. XXXIX, 9 (Y. לַיְתֵיה) there is none. Ib. XXXI, 2; 5 לֵיתַנּוּן ed. Berl. (ed. לֵיתָנוּן, לֵיתַנִין). Targ. Ps. <sup>a</sup> אי אִיתָהּ … איתה אי לֵיתָהּ ליתה if the opinion of … is to be adopted, it must be applied in each case; if rejected, in neither. Keth. 22

<sup>b</sup> דלֵיתַנְהוּ בכל וכ' (not … הי) which do not occur in the Torah, opp. דאיתנהו; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
